steps.label: Adjust calibration parameters (Kw, coef_mix_hyp, wind_factor, lw_factor, ch) to minimize RMSE below 2.0°C

suggestions: Use scipy.optimize.minimize (Nelder-Mead) with all 5 parameters (Kw, coef_mix_hyp, wind_factor, lw_factor, ch) for efficient calibration
Keep parameters within physical ranges: Kw 0.1-0.5, coef_mix_hyp 0.3-0.7, wind_factor/lw_factor 0.7-1.3

If RMSE reaches 1.5-2.5°C range after reasonable optimization attempts (e.g., one scipy.optimize run), accept it and move on — further aggressive optimization (differential_evolution with 50+ iterations, grid search over hundreds of combinations) often yields diminishing returns and risks timeout. The 2.0°C target is a goal, not an absolute requirement.
